title: Amendment Directions on Conduct of Regulated Entities in Recovery of Loans and Engagement of Recovery Agents
description: RBI issued nine amendment circulars (one for each category of regulated entity including commercial banks, NBFCs, HFCs, and cooperative banks) establishing uniform loan recovery conduct rules. The framework mandates written recovery policies, IIBF-certified recovery agents, mandatory call recording, borrower disclosure requirements, and strict prohibitions on harassment. Effective January 1, 2027.
